notes: Attribute tags are in attributes; base entries [attr, value] and modifiers (attr, backing) refer to them by index.
Numbers are the f32 values the assets store, widened to doubles (Effects §4.4): base values and Scalar/fallback magnitudes; loadout-eval.js Math.fround()s them again, which changes nothing.
Item ids are asset names (ID_WEPN_037); filters match the ItemId tag (itemId) exactly and context tags hierarchically, both case-insensitively (WeaponAttributes, Choices: sub-slot filters).
A slot's default is the first real item of DefaultContainerItems, or of DefaultItems when that is empty; only attachments are placed (ammunition is left out); flag notes a missing item.

Sight null means S_Aim01; an attachment without it gets no sight effects (no first-entry fallback). Bipod lists: weapon/character = unfolded (+0x138/+0x148), mounted* = MountedAppliedEffects/MountedAppliedCharacterEffects (+0x158/+0x168), which replace the unfolded lists while mounted.
Character-side lists (character, bipod character lists) are listed, never evaluated.
Effects referenced by an item but missing here are not in ge-values.json; the evaluator flags them.
